configuration_provenance: Readiness test configuration discussed in the setup session; public summary shows one URL but does not expose its method or path.
latency_notes: Public report displays minimum/maximum as 0/0; these are not treated as meaningful latency measurements. P95 is not available in the shared summary. Loader.io timing includes followed redirects.
scope: Hosted readiness/database responsiveness with 1500 clients distributed over 60 seconds; not a simultaneous-chat or Gemini-capacity test.
limitations: 1500 client arrivals are not 1500 concurrent active students.
The readiness endpoint checks database access, documents and Gemini key configuration; it does not generate chat answers or call Gemini.
The report records 1500 followed redirects; this is not a direct HTTPS-only measurement.
No CPU, memory, database saturation, answer-correctness or Gemini-quota measurements were collected by this run.
